body.statement: In Shingaki--Yoshida--Kuroki (2026), Condition 1 is the selected latent proxy factorization whose finite four-response-type specialization is obtained by taking the latent state to encode \((Y(0),Y(1))\).  Their regular Conditions 2--3 impose the stated proxy-matrix invertibility and determinant-ratio separation requirements.  Under those conditions, Theorem 1 identifies PN and PS and Appendix equations (A.28)--(A.33) derive the reported observable formulas.  Their equation (13) is the common-instrument, instrument-exogenous subclass, and Corollary 1 gives the corresponding regular IV-design identification.

source.locator: Condition 1, equation (13), Theorem 1, and Corollary 1, pages 3514--3517; Appendix equations (A.28)--(A.33)
